channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 16B (UCSF planned)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 16B (UCSF planned) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 16B (UCSF planned): Block 16B: UCSF's April 28, 2017 environmental addendum describes an existing Preliminary Utilities Plant there; no later source read confirms it today.
item.description: Block 16B: UCSF's April 28, 2017 environmental addendum describes an existing Preliminary Utilities Plant there; no later source read confirms it today. Source: UCSF Addendum #4 to the 2014 LRDP EIR, 2017-04-28 (regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/may17/f4attach7.pdf); Notice of Determination, SCH 2013092047.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 16B (UCSF planned): Block 16B's 'planned' status now rests on two named sources: UCSF's land-use designation of Blocks 16A and 16B as Research (its June 2025 presentation also says it has 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'), and the University of California's May 6, 2026 approval of the Block 16A Building on 'Block 16A and a portion of Block 16B'. No source gives a project or date for the rest of the block. An earlier line saying no project had been found was out of date.
item.description: Block 16B's 'planned' status now rests on two named sources: UCSF's land-use designation of Blocks 16A and 16B as Research (its June 2025 presentation also says it has 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'), and the University of California's May 6, 2026 approval of the Block 16A Building on 'Block 16A and a portion of Block 16B'. No source gives a project or date for the rest of the block. An earlier line saying no project had been found was out of date. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Planned Development, CAC presentation, June 12, 2025 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); Notice of Determination, Mission Bay Block 16A Building, May 6, 2026 (https://files.ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/246712-20/attachment/0zbP4_YvWhtrOpJtK_YMaC8n6UZ4L3TQolVa5p85OVB1yrByyC4Q0aLzK6aRxnDcq4sEMarnG6PB_0Gg0).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 16B (UCSF planned): The map notes said the block had been confirmed as surface parking from satellite imagery and building footprints; the cited Dec 2019 land use map shows planned uses only and no imagery is cited, so the notes now say the parking use is not confirmed. They now cite UCSF's June 12, 2025 CAC deck, which lists Block 16A & B as an undeveloped parcel planned for research use with no building plans. The timeline entry no longer relies on uncited statements about a Dec 2015 map and the 1998 plan.

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 16B (UCSF planned): The University of California approves the Mission Bay Block 16A Building on 'Block 16A and a portion of Block 16B' (Notice of Determination); UCSF's release forecasts construction from late 2026, completion in 2029 and occupancy in 2030 (see the Block 16A record) (May 6, 2026)
item.description: The University of California approves the Mission Bay Block 16A Building on 'Block 16A and a portion of Block 16B' (Notice of Determination); UCSF's release forecasts construction from late 2026, completion in 2029 and occupancy in 2030 (see the Block 16A record) (May 6, 2026). Source: University of California, Physical & Environmental Planning, 2026-05-06; Mirage News (originating organization: UCSF), 2026-05-07.

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 16B (UCSF planned): OCII's Mission Bay Land Use Map (December 2019) labels this block 16B and shows it in the color its legend labels 'UCSF'; the map names no project. UCSF's June 12, 2025 CAC presentation lists Block 16A & B among undeveloped parcels remaining (use: Research) and says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'. The University of California's Notice of Determination of May 6, 2026 approves the Mission Bay Block 16A Building on 'Block 16A and a portion of Block 16B'; no source names a project for the rest of Block 16B (Dec 2019)
